supersedes.reason: Independent review found clean-provenance races, redirected/swapped write destinations, arbitrary model-manifest inputs, malformed mirror/changelog crashes, and fail-open release headings. This manifest records the complete remediation and Git-filter portability correction.

checks.result: The clean exact remediation commit passed all 14 mandatory foundation commands and all 114 foundation tests; build provenance reported 0.1.0+g91be762 clean.

All 13 focused tests passed, including deterministic clean/dirty output, committed-input race denial, real NTFS junction rejection, parent-swap denial, malformed mirror/changelog handling, exact dates, canonical component/lock inputs, CAP-07 model-manifest gating, and schema/output boundaries.
The exact clean commit generated a confined deterministic manifest using Git-filter-verified checkout inputs and canonical raw HEAD blobs for cross-platform lock/schema provenance.
The ledger and original evidence chain validated with 20 capabilities, 117 slices, 356 tasks, and 12 release gates.

evidence: Generation captures every governed input once, rechecks current bytes, verifies Git state before/mid/final collection, and for clean builds compares each captured input through Git clean filters with the immutable HEAD blob.
Clean dependency and schema identifiers hash canonical raw HEAD blobs, avoiding Windows checkout-line-ending drift; dirty builds hash captured worktree bytes and retain explicit dirty paths.
Canonical directory identity guards reject redirected artifacts/tmp roots and component parents and revalidate parent/root identities immediately before and after atomic replacement.
The model-manifest set is explicitly governed empty until CAP-07 installs its owned contract and inventory; arbitrary files or prematurely installed JSON manifests fail closed.

Thirteen focused tests directly reproduce the review's Cargo.lock race, NTFS junction escape, parent replacement, arbitrary model input, malformed JSON/TOML roots, invalid UTF-8, invalid/duplicate/misordered changelog headings, and all original expected/boundary cases.
The complete clean foundation profile passed 14 commands and 114 tests at exact commit 91be762a85bbecbf57f2a4b8d9eb2260a1653eb9.
All fixed mirror and changelog inputs now use nonredirected before/after identity snapshots and return actionable errors rather than exceptions.
CHANGELOG.md requires exactly one Unreleased heading before releases, exactly one current-version heading, unique release versions, and real ISO calendar dates.

Automation and test documentation now state the Git snapshot, canonical hash, confinement, changelog, and CAP-07 model-manifest boundaries; generated ledger views were regenerated after review-state mutation.

reviewerDisposition.note: Independent re-review must reproduce every prior race, junction/swap, arbitrary model input, malformed mirror/changelog, and dated-heading attack against exact commit 91be762a85bbecbf57f2a4b8d9eb2260a1653eb9, and verify the Git-filter/raw-blob portability boundary.
